arms.arm1_unguided_ecological: Births use learner-internal triggers only: low margin, active atom conflict, novel percept signatures, repeated trace uncertainty, and yoked random births. Survival uses local credit/debt plus passive decay; habitat-local mode restricts decay and competition to revisited percept signatures; graph-native mode stores composites as StemCellTerminal TRIAL/MATURE/PRUNED cells with parent-local resource accounting.
arms.arm2_guided_residual_control: Quarantined expressivity probe. Births are aimed at atom-only failure rows and must not be counted as autogrowth evidence.

cross_experiment_composite_correspondenc.interpretation: safe rook move onto a working edge-distance file/rank under different substrate/economy/opponent
two black-king escape squares sealed; orientation differs but conjunction family recurs

discovery_boundary.exact_judge_use: after-the-fact rollout outcome and heldout ablation only
forbidden_for_arm1_birth: hand chase features as causal features
exact judge failures or success labels
learner_visible: atom weights from sealed Stage B learner
trial composite activations and local nutrition

audition_economy.budget_exhaustion_rule: prune TRIAL cell when audition budget is exhausted with better-worse <= 0
audition_economy.trigger: TRIAL cell requests an audition when its own active-proposal argmax differs from the host-alone argmax on a training ply

ecology.birth_boundary: internal surprise triggers only; guided residual arm quarantined and disabled

birth_throttle.rule: internal spawn triggers fire only into open parent habitat slots

ecology.credit_assignment: per-ply host-alone argmax is compared with host+advisory choice; only cells responsible for a changed choice receive later flip credit/debt
ecology.final_headline_eval: host plus MATURE cells versus host alone; all-live gate also checked for interference

homeostatic_birth_gate.rule: internal spawn triggers fire only when the under-K TRIAL fraction is below the threshold; otherwise the trigger is counted as deferred and may reappear naturally if still valid

recognizers: post-hoc success endpoint fallback if no geometric flip fires

purity_notes.adversarial_black: opponent-side exact-adversarial reply selection in paired virtual rollouts
purity_notes.exact_judges: post-hoc reporting only for audition verdicts
purity_notes.verdict_source: internal recognizer flips from the paired virtual lines
purity_notes.white_move_source: cell's own active-proposal move versus host-alone argmax; no white oracle

recurrence_families.recurrence_rule: same predeclared family matures in at least 3 of 5 seeds

ecology.same_choice_credit: zero nutrition/debt to all cells on plies where cells do not change the host choice

scheduled_auditions.agreement_rule: if all sampled firing positions agree with host-alone for the remaining budget, prune as scheduled_redundancy, distinct from debt pruning
scheduled_auditions.complete_flush_rule: before stability checks, actively scan host trajectories over the segment rows to fill each TRIAL cell's own firing set; spend the remaining per-cell budget, sampling with replacement from that firing set if needed; cells with no firing samples are pruned as no-firing
scheduled_auditions.firing_replay_buffer: training positions tagged by TRIAL cells whose own proposal fired
scheduled_auditions.spontaneous_live_auditions: remain enabled and count against the same per-cell budget

ecology.substrate: GraphNativeCompositeRuntime StemCellTerminal nodes inside the persistent FormalReConEngine graph

host_ladder.frozen_from: Phase 3.15 scheduled audition mechanics, with only flush completion and backlog birth gating added

paired_gate_spec.gate_rule: pass if discordant pairs favor learner, or learner is non-inferior within the declared margin
paired_gate_spec.margin_interpretation: 3/128 = 2.34 percentage points; smaller folds scale proportionally with minimum 1

phase3_15_under_k_diagnosis.conclusion: The 3.15 court was not blocked by the live per-ply audition cap. It reused only the replay firing buffer, so agreement-only cells with fewer than K samples and cells with no buffered firings survived under-K. Birth timing was not stored in 3.15, so late-birth contribution cannot be reconstructed from that artifact.

stop_rules: Arm1 population collapse-to-zero after nonzero births
Arm1 cap pressure on more than half of train decisions
Arm1 load-bearing count remains zero across all seeds
